## Release impact

Tick everything that applies. `/personal-release` reads these boxes to suggest the version and write the release notes.

- [ ] **Breaking:** removes or renames something a user or caller relies on, or changes its meaning. Say what breaks on the line below.
- [ ] **Adds** a feature, command, endpoint, setting or option
- [ ] **Data migration:** changes stored data or its schema. Say what it does to existing data.
- [ ] **Config change:** adds, removes or renames an environment variable or config key. Name each one.
- [ ] **Infrastructure change:** CI, Dockerfile, deploy or scheduling files
